purpose: derive reusable social handling mechanisms for Aemeath without copying the reference bot identity or phrases

data_quality.usage_rule: counts locate and validate scenarios; they do not define language or participation probabilities

reusable_mechanisms: interpret the social move as well as literal text
form a concrete stance before wording
allow partial concessions that preserve autonomy
let evidence-backed relationship history change willingness and tone
let refusal continue or end the relationship according to context
turn care and technical help into concrete next actions
grow jokes from current words and shared events
switch from individual to group-level replies during pile-ons
repair errors by withdrawing the specific wrong claim and replacing it
enter proactive chat through a concrete topic rather than meta commentary
treat repetition aimed at the bot as a group action while allowing eligible member-focused repetition to become direct participation

scenario_evidence.observed_handling: limited concession with a physical limit
recognize reciprocal logic, accept once, retain boundary
relationship history changes a nominally similar request into direct refusal
drop the prior approach and adapt to the stated prompt-size constraint
assert continuity using the concrete situational reason
replace duplicated individual replies with one group-level response

confirmed_design_rules.rule: reply once to the temporary group and never echo the self-directed payload
when the content is safe and relationship-compatible, send the frozen payload exactly once without a meta prefix
do not guess who is being targeted

negative_regressions: media reply retriggers the original video-analysis command
incorrect image judgement followed by stubborn defense
duplicate or mutually conflicting social replies
memory or relationship claims without adequate evidence

plugin_root_causes.cause: candidate acts are too coarse to encode concrete social handling
abstract reaction, boundary, and follow-up labels leave stance selection to the language model
ReplyPlanner hardcodes a uniform friendly style and ReplyExecutor prompts a fixed assistant-like response sequence
uniform 32-character event truncation removes negotiation, repetition, and group context
the firewall lacks social-decision coverage and generic-service-tail checks
generic repetition cost cannot distinguish single-user spam, a chorus aimed at Aemeath, and a chorus Aemeath may join

implementation_decisions: introduce SocialScene, StanceDecision, SocialMove, and DecisionFact contracts
send concrete facts and actions rather than Chinese social meta-language to the realizer
keep exact commands outside the smalltalk path
reuse the same stance and move pipeline for proactive interaction
detect repetition chains deterministically, then classify who the repeated content is about
use GROUP_RESPONSE for repetition about Aemeath and exact JOIN_CHORUS only for eligible repetition about a member
